Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Vandana Sen. I am a 67-year-old cardiologist living in Mysuru. Pandey Enterprises gave me a cheque for ₹24,30,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. My case number is CC/2816/2021 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Mysuru. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 87672 07023 or email vandana.sen@example.com.
